text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Haah, I somehow managed to defeat them, but...  was tough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
どうにか倒せたけど……
手ごわかったわね。

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Minions kept coming one after another...  I was getting anxious when it would end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
後から後から子分が出てきて……
いつ終わるか不安になっちゃいました。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Anyway, it's our victory! ... Well, I want to be happy, but  it seems like there's more work to do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんにせよ、
アタシたちの勝利よ！
……って、
喜びたいところだけど、
それにはもうひと仕事必要みたい。

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: We've come this far, so let's do our best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここまで来たんだもの、
頑張りましょう！
